scope: Show pending files in compact attachment rows
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--file-preview-open-compact-.task: Review filenames, previews and removal actions without crowding out the draft.
conversation--file-preview-open-compact-.observations: The expanded text preview now shows the checklist and final sentence with its filename, removal button and focused disclosure. The attachment region can scroll to the second file. At 760×550 Latest reply sits below the transcript text, and the draft, Add files and Send remain reachable without overlap. Dark contrast is clear.
